description.text: The seventh enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 13 May 2022, led by Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR, a Colorless Pokémon that fits in any deck: its VSTAR Power, the Ability Phantom Star, discards its player's hand to draw seven cards, and its attack does more damage for each of its player's Pokémon with damage counters on it. Hisuian Goodra VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power heals all its damage, Magnezone VSTAR, Gengar, which can come to the Bench straight from the discard pile, and Radiant Gardevoir, Radiant Hisuian Sneasler and Radiant Steelix join it, with the Supporters Volo, Iscan, Arezu and Miss Fortune Sisters and the Stadium Lake Acuity. Each pack held six cards, and some cards also came in premium mirror versions. The cards are numbered to 71, followed by six Character Rare Pokémon drawn with a Trainer, full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, Character Super Rare Enamorus V and Gallade V, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR, Dark Patch and Box of Disaster. In English many of its cards came out in Lost Origin in September 2022, and some in Silver Tempest in November 2022.
